verdict.rationale: Community hands-on reports confirm CLI model download and removal via 'ollama pull' and 'ollama rm', plus running and hot-swapping models via 'ollama run' ([ollama-comm-3], [ollama-comm-4], [ollama-comm-5]). First-party sources mention a REST API for managing models and a web model library, but nothing shows searching the registry from the command line. Missing for 10: CLI model search, first-party CLI documentation for pull/rm/list, other model-management commands (list, show, copy)
